# A chunk of meteor debris: a tiny tumbling rock (the game flings a pool of them out of each burst).
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.435 0.114 0.361 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Chunk --radius 0.09 --subdivisions 1 --location 0 0 0
material assign Rock
mode edit
select vert where "true"
randomize --amount 0.02 --seed 2
mode object
shade flat
export debris.glb
